name: Sungas POS Close · variance_amount Backfill
script:
# Fires Before Save on every POS Closing Shift — computes the signed
# variance from the payment_reconciliation child table and writes it
# to `variance_amount`. Unconditional (not gated on workflow state)
# so warning-tier shifts also populate the field.

total_diff = 0.0
for row in doc.payment_reconciliation or []:
    d = row.get("difference")
    if d is not None:
        total_diff += float(d)

# Round to 2 decimals to avoid float-noise churn.
total_diff = round(total_diff, 2)

# Only write if changed — avoids modified_by churn on every save.
current = doc.get("variance_amount")
if current is None or round(float(current or 0), 2) != total_diff:
    doc.variance_amount = total_diff

name: SE Inter-Outlet SoD Guard V2
Sungas MR — Share With Source PM
script:
# After Save on Material Request.
# The destination-side PM already has read access via their Warehouse
# User Permission on set_warehouse. But the source-outlet PM (who has
# to dispatch the goods) has no UP match — Frappe would 403 them on
# direct URL access. Explicitly SHARE the MR with the source PM using
# Frappe's DocShare primitive: gives them read but not write.

if doc.material_request_type != "Material Transfer":
    pass  # only inter-outlet transfers need cross-outlet sharing

elif not doc.source_outlet:
    pass  # no source outlet to share with

else:
    source_pm = frappe.db.get_value("Warehouse", doc.source_outlet, "outlet_plant_manager")
    if not source_pm:
        pass  # no PM assigned
    elif source_pm == doc.owner:
        pass  # owner already has access
    else:
        # Idempotent — Frappe.share.add_docshare merges if already shared
        try:
            existing = frappe.get_all(
                "DocShare",
                filters={
                    "share_doctype": "Material Request",
                    "share_name": doc.name,
                    "user": source_pm,
                },
                limit=1,
            ) or []
            if not existing:
                share = frappe.new_doc("DocShare")
                share.user = source_pm
                share.share_doctype = "Material Request"
                share.share_name = doc.name
                share.read = 1
                share.write = 0
                share.submit = 0
                share.share = 0
                share.everyone = 0
                share.notify_by_email = 0
                share.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        except Exception as e:
            frappe.log_error(
                "Sungas MR Share failed for " + doc.name + " → " + source_pm + ": " + str(e),
                "Sungas MR Share",
            )

name: SE Single-Drop Spawn
script:
# After Submit on Stock Entry — auto-spawn the paired Draft receipt SE
# at the destination outlet for single-drop Material Transfer outwards
# (source outlet → Goods In Transit - SCL).
#
# Complements "SE Multi-Drop Spawn" which handles is_multi_drop=1.

TRANSIT_WH = "Goods In Transit - SCL"

if doc.stock_entry_type != "Material Transfer":
    pass  # not our concern

elif doc.get("is_multi_drop"):
    pass  # multi-drop handled by SE Multi-Drop Spawn

elif doc.get("is_pr_discharge") or doc.get("pr_reference") or doc.get("pr_reference_new"):
    pass  # PR-discharge SEs have their own spawn logic

elif not doc.to_warehouse or TRANSIT_WH not in doc.to_warehouse:
    pass  # not an outward-to-transit SE — no receipt to spawn

elif not doc.from_warehouse or TRANSIT_WH in doc.from_warehouse:
    pass  # already an inward-from-transit SE; do not spawn again

else:
    # Idempotency: if any Draft/Submitted SE already references this one
    # via outgoing_stock_entry, skip.
    already = frappe.get_all(
        "Stock Entry",
        filters={"outgoing_stock_entry": doc.name},
        fields=["name"],
        limit=1,
    ) or []
    if already:
        pass
    else:
        # Resolve destination outlet from the linked MR (preferred) or from
        # the first item's warehouse hint.
        destination = None
        mr_name = doc.get("material_request_new")
        if mr_name:
            destination = frappe.db.get_value("Material Request", mr_name, "set_warehouse")
        if not destination:
            for it in (doc.items or []):
                # Fallback: MR item's destination warehouse (not the transit hop)
                if it.get("material_request"):
                    mr_item_wh = frappe.db.get_value(
                        "Material Request Item",
                        {"name": it.get("material_request_item")},
                        "warehouse",
                    )
                    if mr_item_wh and mr_item_wh != TRANSIT_WH:
                        destination = mr_item_wh
                        break
        if not destination or destination == TRANSIT_WH:
            pass  # cannot resolve destination — skip
        else:
            receipt = frappe.new_doc("Stock Entry")
            receipt.stock_entry_type = "Material Transfer"
            receipt.company = doc.company
            receipt.purpose = "Material Transfer"
            receipt.from_warehouse = TRANSIT_WH
            receipt.to_warehouse = destination
            receipt.outgoing_stock_entry = doc.name
            receipt.posting_date = frappe.utils.today()
            receipt.set_posting_time = 0

            if mr_name:
                receipt.material_request_new = mr_name
            if doc.get("loading_schedule"):
                receipt.loading_schedule = doc.get("loading_schedule")

            for it in (doc.items or []):
                receipt.append("items", {
                    "item_code": it.item_code,
                    "qty": it.qty,
                    "uom": it.uom or "Kg",
                    "stock_uom": it.stock_uom or "Kg",
                    "conversion_factor": it.conversion_factor or 1,
                    "s_warehouse": TRANSIT_WH,
                    "t_warehouse": destination,
                    "basic_rate": it.basic_rate,
                    # NB: do NOT propagate material_request / material_request_item to
                    # the receipt items. ERPNext validates the MR quota by summing all
                    # SE items[].material_request, and counting both outward (source→GIT)
                    # and inward (GIT→dest) legs against one MR item double-counts.
                    # Parent-level material_request_new preserves audit traceability.
                })

            try:
                receipt.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
                frappe.msgprint(
                    "Draft receipt " + receipt.name + " created at " + destination + ".",
                    alert=True, indicator="green",
                )
            except Exception as e:
                frappe.log_error(
                    "SE Single-Drop Spawn failed for " + doc.name + ": " + str(e),
                    "Sungas SE Auto-Spawn",
                )

name: Sungas DLS — Drop Integrity Guard
SE Multi-Drop Spawn
script:
# After Submit on Stock Entry.
# For dispatch SEs with is_multi_drop=1, spawn N Draft receipt SEs at each destination.
# Idempotent: skips rows that already have receipt_stock_entry set.

if not doc.get("is_multi_drop"):
    pass  # nothing to do — single-drop follows native outgoing_stock_entry flow

elif doc.get("is_pr_discharge") or doc.get("pr_reference") or doc.get("pr_reference_new"):
    pass  # PR-discharge SEs have their own spawn logic in Stage 2

else:
    allocations = doc.get("destination_allocations") or []
    if not allocations:
        pass  # marked multi-drop but nothing to spawn — misconfiguration; ignore

    else:
        # Determine transit warehouse — Sungas inter-outlet uses Goods In Transit - SCL
        transit_wh = "Goods In Transit - SCL"

        spawned = []
        for alloc in allocations:
            # Idempotency guard
            if alloc.get("receipt_stock_entry"):
                continue
            if not alloc.get("destination_outlet") or not alloc.get("item_code"):
                continue

            qty = alloc.get("weighbridge_qty") or alloc.get("allocated_qty") or 0
            if qty <= 0:
                continue

            # Build the receipt SE (Material Transfer, Draft)
            receipt = frappe.new_doc("Stock Entry")
            receipt.stock_entry_type = "Material Transfer"
            receipt.company = doc.company
            receipt.purpose = "Material Transfer"
            receipt.from_warehouse = transit_wh
            receipt.to_warehouse = alloc.get("destination_outlet")
            receipt.outgoing_stock_entry = doc.name
            receipt.posting_date = frappe.utils.today()
            receipt.set_posting_time = 0

            # Custom Stage 4 links
            if alloc.get("material_request"):
                receipt.material_request_new = alloc.get("material_request")
            if doc.get("loading_schedule"):
                receipt.loading_schedule = doc.get("loading_schedule")

            # Item row
            receipt.append("items", {
                "item_code": alloc.get("item_code"),
                "qty": qty,
                "uom": "Kg",
                "stock_uom": "Kg",
                "conversion_factor": 1,
                "s_warehouse": transit_wh,
                "t_warehouse": alloc.get("destination_outlet"),
            })

            try:
                receipt.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
                # Back-write onto the dispatch's Destination Allocation row
                alloc.receipt_stock_entry = receipt.name

                # Back-write onto the Loading Schedule's Schedule Drops row
                if doc.get("loading_schedule") and alloc.get("material_request"):
                    ls = frappe.get_doc("Daily Loading Schedule", doc.get("loading_schedule"))
                    for drop in (ls.drops or []):
                        if drop.material_request == alloc.get("material_request") and not drop.receipt_stock_entry:
                            drop.receipt_stock_entry = receipt.name
                            drop.state = "Dispatched"
                    ls.save(ignore_permissions=True)

                spawned.append({
                    "receipt_se": receipt.name,
                    "destination": alloc.get("destination_outlet"),
                    "qty": qty,
                })
            except Exception as e:
                frappe.log_error(
                    title=f"SE Multi-Drop Spawn failed for {doc.name} → {alloc.get('destination_outlet')}",
                    message=frappe.get_traceback(),
                )

        # Persist the back-writes onto the dispatch doc
        if spawned:
            doc.db_update_all()
            # NB: frappe.db.commit() removed — safe_exec blocks it; Frappe commits at end of txn automatically

        # Optional: message the user submitting for visibility
        if spawned:
            frappe.msgprint(
                f"Spawned {len(spawned)} Draft receipt Stock Entries at destinations.",
                title="Multi-Drop Dispatch",
                indicator="green",
            )

MR Attach To Loading Schedule
script:
# After Save on Material Request.
# Attaches approved MRs to the appropriate source's Draft Loading Schedule.

if int(doc.docstatus or 0) != 1:
    pass  # only auto-attach on Submit — not on Draft save

elif doc.material_request_type != "Material Transfer":
    pass  # not our concern

elif not doc.get("hoo_approved"):
    pass  # not yet approved — nothing to attach

elif doc.get("loading_schedule"):
    pass  # already attached — idempotent skip

elif not doc.get("source_outlet"):
    pass  # missing source — cannot attach

elif doc.get("emergency"):
    # Emergency Override — do NOT auto-attach; HoO handles flash-truck logistics
    if not doc.get("approval_reason") or "Flash truck" not in (doc.approval_reason or ""):
        doc.approval_reason = (doc.approval_reason or "") + " · Flash truck logistics — HoO to assign manually"
        doc.db_set("approval_reason", doc.approval_reason, update_modified=False)

else:
    # Determine target schedule_date based on current time vs cutoff
    company_name = doc.company or frappe.db.get_single_value("Global Defaults", "default_company")
    company = frappe.get_cached_doc("Company", company_name) if company_name else None
    cutoff_hour = int((company and company.get("cutoff_preliminary_hour")) or 15)

    now_dt = frappe.utils.now_datetime()
    today_str = frappe.utils.today()
    if now_dt.hour < cutoff_hour:
        target_date = today_str
    else:
        target_date = frappe.utils.add_days(today_str, 1)

    # Find or create the Draft Loading Schedule for (source, date)
    existing = frappe.get_all(
        "Daily Loading Schedule",
        filters={
            "source_outlet": doc.source_outlet,
            "schedule_date": target_date,
            "state": "Draft",
        },
        fields=["name"],
        limit_page_length=1,
    )

    if existing:
        ls = frappe.get_doc("Daily Loading Schedule", existing[0]["name"])
    else:
        ls = frappe.new_doc("Daily Loading Schedule")
        ls.source_outlet = doc.source_outlet
        ls.schedule_date = target_date
        ls.state = "Draft"
        ls.truck_no = "TBD"
        ls.truck_capacity_kg = 8000
        ls.vehicle_class = "Tanker 8t"
        # Cutoff timestamps for the schedule
        cutoff_prelim_hour = int((company and company.get("cutoff_preliminary_hour")) or 15)
        cutoff_hard_hour = int((company and company.get("cutoff_hard_hour")) or 17)
        ls.cutoff_preliminary_at = f"{target_date} {cutoff_prelim_hour:02d}:00:00"
        ls.cutoff_hard_at = f"{target_date} {cutoff_hard_hour:02d}:00:00"
        ls.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

    # Compute total kg from MR items (may span multiple lines / dest)
    # Group by destination_outlet so each destination gets one Schedule Drop row.
    drop_by_dest = {}
    for row in (doc.items or []):
        dest = row.warehouse
        if not dest:
            continue
        key = (dest, row.item_code)
        current = drop_by_dest.get(key, {"qty": 0, "uom": row.uom or "Kg"})
        current["qty"] = (current["qty"] or 0) + (row.qty or 0)
        drop_by_dest[key] = current

    # Append one Schedule Drop per (destination, item)
    existing_seqs = [d.sequence or 0 for d in (ls.drops or [])]
    next_seq = (max(existing_seqs) if existing_seqs else 0) + 1

    # Bind doc.name to local var — safe_exec generator scoping quirk
    mr_name = doc.name
    existing_drops = ls.drops or []

    for (dest, item_code), agg in drop_by_dest.items():
        # Check: was this MR already dropped onto this schedule? (defensive)
        already_dropped = False
        for d in existing_drops:
            if d.material_request == mr_name and d.destination_outlet == dest and d.item_code == item_code:
                already_dropped = True
                break
        if already_dropped:
            continue

        ls.append("drops", {
            "sequence": next_seq,
            "material_request": mr_name,
            "destination_outlet": dest,
            "item_code": item_code,
            "qty": agg["qty"],
            "uom": agg["uom"],
            "state": "Pending",
        })
        next_seq += 1

    ls.save(ignore_permissions=True)

    # Link the MR back to the schedule
    doc.db_set("loading_schedule", ls.name, update_modified=False)

script:
# Sungas · Stock Entry row-level scope.
# Plant Managers see SEs tied to their own outlet (as source or destination,
# or the paired outward SE via outgoing_stock_entry). Privileged roles and
# owners always see their records.

user = frappe.session.user
if user == "Administrator" or user == "lmd-bot@sungas.org" or user == "Guest":
    conditions = ""
else:
    roles = frappe.get_all("Has Role", filters={"parent": user}, pluck="role") or []
    priv = ["System Manager", "LPG Head of Operations",
            "LPG Chief Operating Officer", "LPG Head of Finance",
            "Stock Manager", "Accounts Manager", "Purchase Manager"]
    is_privileged = False
    for r in priv:
        if r in roles:
            is_privileged = True
    if is_privileged:
        conditions = ""
    else:
        wh_rows = frappe.get_all(
            "Warehouse",
            filters={"outlet_plant_manager": user, "disabled": 0},
            pluck="name"
        ) or []
        wh_names = []
        for n in wh_rows:
            wh_names.append("'" + n.replace("'", "''") + "'")
        user_esc = user.replace("'", "''")
        if wh_names:
            wh_list = ",".join(wh_names)
            # Allow SEs where user owns it, OR from/to warehouse is theirs,
            # OR the paired outward SE's to_warehouse is theirs (i.e. they
            # own the destination of a transfer whose source SE lives at
            # another outlet).
            conditions = (
                "(`tabStock Entry`.owner='" + user_esc + "' "
                "OR `tabStock Entry`.from_warehouse IN (" + wh_list + ") "
                "OR `tabStock Entry`.to_warehouse IN (" + wh_list + ") "
                "OR `tabStock Entry`.outgoing_stock_entry IN ("
                "  SELECT name FROM `tabStock Entry` src "
                "  WHERE src.to_warehouse IN (" + wh_list + ")"
                ") "
                "OR EXISTS ("
                "  SELECT 1 FROM `tabStock Entry` dst "
                "  WHERE dst.outgoing_stock_entry=`tabStock Entry`.name "
                "  AND dst.to_warehouse IN (" + wh_list + ")"
                "))"
            )
        else:
            conditions = "`tabStock Entry`.owner='" + user_esc + "'"

name: MR Auto-Approve Rules
script:
# Fires on Material Request Before Save. Sets hoo_approved=1 if any rule matches.
# Only touches inter-outlet transfers (material_request_type == "Material Transfer"
# and source_outlet custom field set).

if doc.material_request_type != "Material Transfer":
    pass  # not our concern — regular MRs unchanged

elif not doc.get("source_outlet"):
    pass  # missing source — leave for HoO to review manually

elif int(doc.hoo_approved or 0) == 1 or int(frappe.form_dict.get("hoo_approved") or 0) == 1:
    pass  # already approved (auto or manual) — do not re-evaluate

else:
    # Compute total qty across MR items (LPG bulk kg)
    total_kg = sum((row.qty or 0) for row in (doc.items or []))

    # Destination: first row's warehouse
    dest = None
    if doc.items:
        dest = doc.items[0].warehouse

    # Company defaults
    company_name = doc.company or frappe.db.get_single_value("Global Defaults", "default_company")
    company = frappe.get_cached_doc("Company", company_name) if company_name else None
    auto_approve_kg = float((company and company.get("auto_approve_bulk_kg")) or 2000)
    emerg_cap = int((company and company.get("emergency_override_monthly_cap_per_pm")) or 3)

    # --- RULE 1: Emergency Override ---
    if doc.get("emergency"):
        if not doc.get("emergency_reason"):
            frappe.throw("Emergency Override requires a written emergency_reason.")

        # Count this PM's emergency uses this calendar month
        first_of_month = frappe.utils.get_first_day(frappe.utils.nowdate())
        used_this_month = frappe.db.count("Material Request", {
            "emergency": 1,
            "owner": doc.owner,
            "creation": [">=", first_of_month],
            "name": ["!=", doc.name],
        })
        if used_this_month >= emerg_cap:
            frappe.throw(
                f"Emergency Override monthly cap reached ({used_this_month}/{emerg_cap} for {doc.owner}). "
                f"Route this through HoO for approval instead."
            )
        doc.hoo_approved = 1
        doc.hoo_approved_by = frappe.session.user
        doc.hoo_approved_at = frappe.utils.now_datetime()
        doc.requires_post_hoc_signoff = 1
        doc.approval_reason = (
            f"EMERGENCY OVERRIDE ({used_this_month + 1}/{emerg_cap} this month) — "
            f"post-hoc HoO signoff required within 24h"
        )
        doc.escalation_level = 0

    else:
        # --- RULE 2: Standing Agreement match ---
        matched_sa = None
        if doc.source_outlet and dest:
            candidates = frappe.get_all(
                "Inter-Outlet Standing Agreement",
                filters={
                    "source_outlet": doc.source_outlet,
                    "destination_outlet": dest,
                    "is_active": 1,
                },
                fields=["name", "daily_cap_kg", "weekly_cap_kg", "allow_secondary_same_day_run"],
            )
            for sa in candidates:
                if total_kg <= sa["daily_cap_kg"]:
                    # (Weekly cap enforcement deferred to Part 3 — needs rolling window aggregation)
                    matched_sa = sa
                    break

        if matched_sa:
            doc.hoo_approved = 1
            doc.hoo_approved_by = "lmd-bot@sungas.org"
            doc.hoo_approved_at = frappe.utils.now_datetime()
            doc.standing_agreement = matched_sa["name"]
            doc.approval_reason = (
                f"Auto-approved under {matched_sa['name']} "
                f"(cap {matched_sa['daily_cap_kg']:.0f}kg; requested {total_kg:.0f}kg)"
            )
            doc.escalation_level = 0

        # --- RULE 3: Volume threshold ---
        elif total_kg <= auto_approve_kg:
            doc.hoo_approved = 1
            doc.hoo_approved_by = "lmd-bot@sungas.org"
            doc.hoo_approved_at = frappe.utils.now_datetime()
            doc.approval_reason = (
                f"Auto-approved under volume threshold "
                f"({total_kg:.0f}kg <= {auto_approve_kg:.0f}kg bulk cap)"
            )
            doc.escalation_level = 0

        # --- Else: routes to HoO ---
        else:
            doc.hoo_approved = 0
            doc.approval_reason = (
                f"Awaiting HoO approval — {total_kg:.0f}kg above auto-approve threshold "
                f"({auto_approve_kg:.0f}kg) and no matching Standing Agreement"
            )
            doc.escalation_level = 0

name: LS Capacity Check
script:
# Before Save on Daily Loading Schedule.
# Validates total drop qty <= truck capacity.
# Warns (does not block) on source-stock shortfall — the schedule can stay
# Draft while HoO decides split/reroute.

total_kg = sum((d.qty or 0) for d in (doc.drops or []))

if doc.truck_capacity_kg and total_kg > doc.truck_capacity_kg:
    frappe.throw(
        f"Overload — {total_kg:.0f} kg on truck {doc.truck_no} but capacity is "
        f"{doc.truck_capacity_kg:.0f} kg. Split to a 2nd truck or defer drops."
    )

# Source-stock shortfall (only warn on hard-lock; don't block Drafts)
if doc.state == "Locked" and doc.source_outlet:
    # Aggregate demand per item across all drops
    demand_by_item = {}
    for d in (doc.drops or []):
        if not d.item_code:
            continue
        demand_by_item[d.item_code] = demand_by_item.get(d.item_code, 0) + (d.qty or 0)

    for item_code, demand_kg in demand_by_item.items():
        available = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Bin",
            {"item_code": item_code, "warehouse": doc.source_outlet},
            "actual_qty",
        ) or 0
        safety_buffer = 200  # kg
        if demand_kg > (available - safety_buffer):
            # Add a message but don't throw at Lock time — allow HoO manual override
            # via 'Confirm despite shortage' pattern (Part 3)
            frappe.msgprint(
                f"⚠️ Source short on {item_code}: demand {demand_kg:.0f} kg, "
                f"available {available:.0f} kg (buffer {safety_buffer}). "
                f"Consider split or reroute before dispatch.",
                title="Source Capacity Warning",
                indicator="orange",
            )

name: LS Truck-Return Guard
script:
# Before Save on Daily Loading Schedule.
# Prevents assigning a truck to a new schedule while its previous schedule
# is still Locked / Loading / Dispatched (i.e. trip not closed).

if not doc.truck_no:
    pass  # nothing to guard

else:
    open_trips = frappe.get_all(
        "Daily Loading Schedule",
        filters={
            "truck_no": doc.truck_no,
            "state": ["in", ["Locked", "Loading", "Dispatched"]],
            "name": ["!=", doc.name or ""],
        },
        fields=["name", "state", "schedule_date"],
        limit_page_length=5,
    )
    if open_trips:
        trip = open_trips[0]
        frappe.throw(
            f"Truck {doc.truck_no} is still on trip {trip['name']} "
            f"(state: {trip['state']}, date: {trip['schedule_date']}). "
            f"Reconcile all Material Requests on that trip before reloading. "
            f"Use 'Force Close Trip' (HoO only) if the truck cannot return."
        )

name: Outlet SE Open Transit Loss Case
script:
# SCL — Stage 2.6 v2: After Submit on the spawned outlet SE, detect shortfall vs PR # waybill qty and clear the residual in 1626 via a Material Issue with # expense_account=1609 (Transit Loss suspense). Then open a Transit Loss Variance Case. # This works around the ERPNext constraint that Stock-type accounts cannot be touched by JEs. if not doc.get('pr_reference'): pass elif doc.purpose != 'Material Transfer': pass else: pr = frappe.get_doc('Purchase Receipt', doc.pr_reference) git_wh = 'Goods in Transit from Suppliers - SCL' policy_doc = frappe.get_doc('Sungas Close Policy', 'Sungas Close Policy') suspense_acc = policy_doc.get('tl_suspense_account') or '1609 - GIT - Transit Loss - SCL' pr_qty_by_item = {} pr_rate_by_item = {} for r in (pr.items or []): pr_qty_by_item[r.item_code] = pr_qty_by_item.get(r.item_code, 0) + (r.qty or 0) pr_rate_by_item[r.item_code] = r.basic_rate or r.rate or 0 se_qty_by_item = {} for r in (doc.items or []): se_qty_by_item[r.item_code] = se_qty_by_item.get(r.item_code, 0) + (r.qty or 0) short_lines = [] total_waybill = 0.0 total_received = 0.0 total_value_short = 0.0 for item_code, qw in pr_qty_by_item.items(): qr = se_qty_by_item.get(item_code, 0) total_waybill = total_waybill + qw total_received = total_received + qr if qw > qr: short_qty = qw - qr rate = pr_rate_by_item.get(item_code, 0) total_value_short = total_value_short + (short_qty * rate) short_lines.append({'item_code': item_code, 'qty': short_qty, 'rate': rate}) shortfall_qty = total_waybill - total_received shortfall_pct = 0.0 if total_waybill > 0: shortfall_pct = (shortfall_qty / total_waybill) * 100 co = frappe.get_doc('Company', doc.company) threshold = co.get('transit_variance_threshold_pct') or 0.5 if shortfall_qty <= 0 or abs(shortfall_pct) < threshold: pass else: # Clear the residual in 1626 via Material Issue with expense_account=1609. clear_se = frappe.new_doc('Stock Entry') clear_se.stock_entry_type = 'Material Issue' clear_se.purpose = 'Material Issue' clear_se.company = doc.company clear_se.from_warehouse = git_wh clear_se.set_posting_time = 1 clear_se.remarks = 'SCL Transit-loss clear — PR %s SE %s waybill %s' % (pr.name, doc.name, pr.get('waybill_number') or '') clear_se.pr_reference = pr.name clear_se.pr_hauler = pr.get('hauler') clear_se.pr_truck_registration = pr.get('truck_registration') clear_se.pr_waybill_number = pr.get('waybill_number') # Patch 0014b -- nudge posting_time +1s so Frappe reads GIT balance # AFTER the plant SE committed, not simultaneously (which reads 0). def p0014b_nudge(ts, seconds): # ts is 'HH:MM:SS' or 'HH:MM:SS.ffffff'; return a nudged HH:MM:SS # clamped to 23:59:59. if not ts: ts = '00:00:00' parts = str(ts).split(':') hh = int(parts[0]); mm = int(parts[1]); ss = int(float(parts[2])) total = hh * 3600 + mm * 60 + ss + int(seconds) if total >= 86400: total = 86399 nh = total // 3600 nm = (total % 3600) // 60 nss = total % 60 return '%02d:%02d:%02d' % (nh, nm, nss) clear_se.posting_date = doc.posting_date clear_se.posting_time = p0014b_nudge(doc.posting_time, 1) for sl in short_lines: clear_se.append('items', { 'item_code': sl['item_code'], 'qty': sl['qty'], 's_warehouse': git_wh, 'basic_rate': sl['rate'], 'expense_account': suspense_acc, }) clear_se.insert(ignore_permissions=True) clear_se.submit() # Open Case case = frappe.new_doc('Transit Loss Variance Case') case.title = 'TLVC %s @ %s — %.2f kg' % (pr.get('waybill_number') or '', doc.to_warehouse, shortfall_qty) case.purchase_receipt = pr.name case.outlet_receipt_se = doc.name case.company = doc.company case.destination_warehouse = doc.to_warehouse case.supplier = pr.supplier case.hauler = pr.get('hauler') case.hauler_type = pr.get('hauler_type') or '3rd Party' case.in_house_driver = pr.get('in_house_driver') case.waybill_number = pr.get('waybill_number') case.truck_registration = pr.get('truck_registration') case.qty_waybilled = total_waybill case.qty_received = total_received case.qty_shortfall = shortfall_qty case.shortfall_pct = shortfall_pct case.shortfall_value = total_value_short case.threshold_pct = threshold case.resolution = 'Pending' case.insert(ignore_permissions=True) try: recipients = [] wh_doc = frappe.get_doc('Warehouse', doc.to_warehouse) for u in [wh_doc.get('outlet_plant_manager'), wh_doc.get('outlet_secondary_manager')]: if u and ('@' in u) and (u != 'Administrator') and (u not in recipients): recipients.append(u) for role in ['LPG Head of Operations','Purchase Manager','Accounts Manager']: rs = frappe.db.get_all('Has Role', filters={'role': role, 'parenttype': 'User'}, fields=['parent']) for hr in rs: u = hr.parent if u and ('@' in u) and (u != 'Administrator') and (u not in recipients): recipients.append(u) if recipients: frappe.sendmail( recipients=recipients, subject='[SCL] Transit Loss Variance Case %s — %.2f kg short' % (case.name, shortfall_qty), message=('

A transit-loss variance has been auto-opened.

' '
  • Case: %s
  • PR: %s
    • ' '
  • Outlet SE: %s
  • Outlet: %s
    • ' '
  • Hauler: %s
  • Truck: %s
    • ' '
  • Waybill: %s
    • ' '
  • Waybill qty: %.2f kg
    • ' '
  • Received qty: %.2f kg
    • ' '
  • Shortfall: %.2f kg (%.4f%% — threshold %.2f%%)
    • ' '
  • ₦ value: %s
    • ' '
  • Clearing SE: %s
' '

Please investigate and submit the case with resolution ' 'Hauler Liable or Written Off.

') % (case.name, pr.name, doc.name, doc.to_warehouse, pr.get('hauler') or '-', pr.get('truck_registration') or '-', pr.get('waybill_number') or '-', total_waybill, total_received, shortfall_qty, shortfall_pct, threshold, total_value_short, clear_se.name), reference_doctype='Transit Loss Variance Case', reference_name=case.name, now=False, ) except Exception as e: frappe.log_error(title='Transit Loss notify failed', message=str(e))

name: Transit Loss Case Resolve
script:
# SCL — Stage 2.8: policy-driven recovery + write-off accounts.
# Reads from Sungas Close Policy:
#   tl_suspense_account               (default 1609 - GIT - Transit Loss)
#   tl_writeoff_account               (default 8600 - COS - Transit Loss (LPG))
#   it_employee_recoverable_account   (shared with Stage 2.2 — staff/driver recovery target)
if doc.resolution == 'Pending':
    frappe.throw('Resolution must be set to Hauler Liable, Driver Liable, or Written Off before submitting.')
elif doc.get('resolution_journal_entry'):
    pass
else:
    amount = doc.shortfall_value or 0
    if amount <= 0:
        frappe.throw('Shortfall value must be > 0 to resolve a case.')
    policy = frappe.get_doc('Sungas Close Policy', 'Sungas Close Policy')
    suspense    = policy.get('tl_suspense_account')             or '1609 - GIT - Transit Loss - SCL'
    writeoff    = policy.get('tl_writeoff_account')             or '8600 - COS - Transit Loss (LPG) - SCL'
    staff_recov = policy.get('it_employee_recoverable_account') or '2610 - Staff Variance Recovery - SCL'
    htype = doc.get('hauler_type') or '3rd Party'
    if doc.resolution == 'Hauler Liable' and htype != '3rd Party':
        frappe.throw('Hauler Liable is only valid when Hauler Type = 3rd Party. This is %s; use Driver Liable.' % htype)
    if doc.resolution == 'Driver Liable' and htype != 'In-house':
        frappe.throw('Driver Liable is only valid when Hauler Type = In-house. This is %s; use Hauler Liable.' % htype)
    je = frappe.new_doc('Journal Entry')
    je.posting_date = frappe.utils.nowdate()
    je.company = doc.company
    je.voucher_type = 'Journal Entry'
    if doc.resolution == 'Hauler Liable':
        co = frappe.get_doc('Company', doc.company)
        payable_account = co.default_payable_account
        if not payable_account:
            frappe.throw('Company default payable account not set; cannot post hauler charge.')
        if not doc.hauler:
            frappe.throw('Hauler is empty on the case.')
        je.user_remark = 'SCL Transit Loss — 3rd-party hauler %s liable (case %s)' % (doc.hauler, doc.name)
        je.append('accounts', {'account': payable_account, 'party_type':'Supplier','party':doc.hauler,'debit_in_account_currency':amount,'company':doc.company})
        je.append('accounts', {'account': suspense, 'credit_in_account_currency': amount, 'company': doc.company})
    elif doc.resolution == 'Driver Liable':
        if not doc.in_house_driver:
            frappe.throw('In-house Driver is empty on the case.')
        je.user_remark = 'SCL Transit Loss — in-house driver %s liable (case %s)' % (doc.in_house_driver, doc.name)
        je.append('accounts', {'account': staff_recov, 'party_type':'Employee','party':doc.in_house_driver,'debit_in_account_currency':amount,'company':doc.company})
        je.append('accounts', {'account': suspense, 'credit_in_account_currency': amount, 'company': doc.company})
    elif doc.resolution == 'Written Off':
        if not (doc.get('hod_finance_signed_by') or '').strip():
            frappe.throw('Transit Loss write-offs require explicit sign-off from LPG Head of Finance. Click the Approve Write-Off as HoF button on this case first (available only to the HoF role).')
        je.user_remark = 'SCL Transit Loss — written off (case %s)' % doc.name
        je.append('accounts', {'account': writeoff, 'debit_in_account_currency': amount, 'company': doc.company})
        je.append('accounts', {'account': suspense, 'credit_in_account_currency': amount, 'company': doc.company})
    else:
        frappe.throw('Unknown resolution: %s' % doc.resolution)
    je.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    je.submit()
    doc.resolution_journal_entry = je.name
    doc.hod_ops_signed_by = frappe.session.user
    doc.hod_ops_signed_on = frappe.utils.now_datetime()

name: Inter-Outlet Open Variance Case on Receipt
script:
# SCL — Stage 2.2 Inter-Outlet Variance Investigation. # Fires AFTER a receiving leg of a Material Transfer is submitted with # variance > 0. Posts a Material Issue Stock Entry from GIT to clear the # residual physical qty out of GIT, expensing the value into the Variance # Investigation Suspense account (2609). Then opens a Draft Inter-Outlet # Variance Case for HOD Ops to investigate and resolve. # NOTE: A Journal Entry cannot touch a Stock-type account directly # (ERPNext perpetual inventory rule). We must use a Stock Entry. if doc.purpose != 'Material Transfer': pass elif not doc.get('outgoing_stock_entry'): pass elif (doc.get('add_to_transit') or 0): pass elif (doc.get('variance_pct') or 0) <= 0: pass else: outgoing_doc = frappe.get_doc('Stock Entry', doc.outgoing_stock_entry) git_wh = 'Goods In Transit - SCL' # Patch 0014 -- Multi-drop guard. If other receiving SEs still reference # the same outgoing dispatch (either Draft or Submitted), DEFER the # auto-clearing until the LAST sibling drop. Otherwise the first # drop's variance drains GIT and robs subsequent drops of the stock # that was staged for them. Also recompute the true loss against the # SUM of sibling received qtys, not just this leg's qty. draft_siblings = frappe.db.count('Stock Entry', { 'outgoing_stock_entry': doc.outgoing_stock_entry, 'docstatus': 0, 'name': ['!=', doc.name], }) po14_defer = (draft_siblings > 0) if po14_defer: frappe.log_error( title='Inter-outlet clearing DEFERRED (multi-drop pending)', message=('Receiving SE %s part of multi-drop dispatch %s. ' '%s sibling receiving SE(s) still Draft. ' 'Clearing + case opening deferred until last sibling submits.' ) % (doc.name, doc.outgoing_stock_entry, draft_siblings) ) if po14_defer: suspense_acc = '2609 - Stock Variance In Transit Recovery - SCL' else: policy = frappe.get_doc('Sungas Close Policy', 'Sungas Close Policy') suspense_acc = policy.get('it_suspense_account') or '2609 - Stock Variance In Transit Recovery - SCL' # 1) Compute per-item shortfall dispatched = {} rates = {} for r in outgoing_doc.items or []: dispatched[r.item_code] = dispatched.get(r.item_code, 0) + (r.qty or 0) rates[r.item_code] = r.basic_rate or r.valuation_rate or 0 # Patch 0014 -- Sum received across THIS leg AND every submitted sibling # so the shortfall math reflects the whole multi-drop trip, not just one drop. received = {} for r in doc.items or []: received[r.item_code] = received.get(r.item_code, 0) + (r.qty or 0) sibling_names = frappe.db.get_all('Stock Entry', filters={ 'outgoing_stock_entry': doc.outgoing_stock_entry, 'docstatus': 1, 'name': ['!=', doc.name], }, pluck='name') for sib_name in sibling_names: for r in frappe.get_all('Stock Entry Detail', filters={'parent': sib_name}, fields=['item_code', 'qty']): received[r['item_code']] = received.get(r['item_code'], 0) + (r['qty'] or 0) shortfall_rows = [] total_value = 0 for code in dispatched: diff = dispatched[code] - received.get(code, 0) if diff > 0: shortfall_rows.append({'item_code': code, 'qty': diff, 'rate': rates.get(code, 0)}) total_value = total_value + (diff * rates.get(code, 0)) if po14_defer or not shortfall_rows or total_value <= 0: pass else: # 2) Create Material Issue from GIT, expense to suspense clearing = frappe.new_doc('Stock Entry') clearing.stock_entry_type = 'Material Issue' clearing.purpose = 'Material Issue' clearing.company = doc.company clearing.from_warehouse = git_wh clearing.posting_date = doc.posting_date clearing.set_posting_time = 1 # Patch 0014b -- nudge posting_time +1s so Frappe reads GIT balance # AFTER the receiving SE committed, not simultaneously (which reads 0). def p0014b_nudge(ts, seconds): # ts is 'HH:MM:SS' or 'HH:MM:SS.ffffff'; return a nudged HH:MM:SS # clamped to 23:59:59. if not ts: ts = '00:00:00' parts = str(ts).split(':') hh = int(parts[0]); mm = int(parts[1]); ss = int(float(parts[2])) total = hh * 3600 + mm * 60 + ss + int(seconds) if total >= 86400: total = 86399 nh = total // 3600 nm = (total % 3600) // 60 nss = total % 60 return '%02d:%02d:%02d' % (nh, nm, nss) clearing.posting_time = p0014b_nudge(doc.posting_time, 1) for r in shortfall_rows: clearing.append('items', { 'item_code': r['item_code'], 'qty': r['qty'], 'uom': 'Nos', 'stock_uom': 'Nos', 'conversion_factor': 1, 's_warehouse': git_wh, 'basic_rate': r['rate'], 'expense_account': suspense_acc, }) clearing.insert(ignore_permissions=True) clearing.submit() # 3) Open Draft variance case qty_disp = 0 qty_recv = 0 for r in (outgoing_doc.items or []): qty_disp = qty_disp + (r.qty or 0) for r in (doc.items or []): qty_recv = qty_recv + (r.qty or 0) variance_pct = doc.get('variance_pct') or 0 case = frappe.new_doc('Inter-Outlet Variance Case') case.dispatch_entry = doc.outgoing_stock_entry case.receipt_entry = doc.name case.source_warehouse = outgoing_doc.from_warehouse case.destination_warehouse = doc.to_warehouse case.company = doc.company case.transfer_purpose = doc.get('transfer_purpose') case.qty_dispatched = qty_disp case.qty_received = qty_recv case.qty_variance = qty_disp - qty_recv case.variance_pct = variance_pct case.value_variance = total_value case.variance_severity = 'Critical' if variance_pct >= 5 else ('Warning' if variance_pct >= 2 else 'Notice') case.variance_reason = doc.get('variance_reason') case.clearing_stock_entry = clearing.name case.title = ('Variance %.2f%% — %s → %s — %s' % (variance_pct, outgoing_doc.from_warehouse, doc.to_warehouse, doc.name)) case.insert(ignore_permissions=True) # 4) Notify HOD Ops via email try: # Notify HOD Ops (variance investigation) + the destination outlet's plant manager. recipients = [] wh_doc = frappe.get_doc('Warehouse', doc.to_warehouse) for u in [wh_doc.get('outlet_plant_manager'), wh_doc.get('outlet_secondary_manager')]: if u and ('@' in u) and (u != 'Administrator') and (u not in recipients): recipients.append(u) hod_rows = frappe.db.get_all('Has Role', filters={'role': 'LPG Head of Operations', 'parenttype': 'User'}, fields=['parent']) for hr in hod_rows: u = hr.parent if u and ('@' in u) and (u != 'Administrator') and (u not in recipients): recipients.append(u) if recipients: frappe.sendmail( recipients=recipients, subject='[SCL] Inter-Outlet Variance Case Opened — %s' % case.name, message=( '

A new Inter-Outlet Variance Case has been opened for your review.

' '
    ' '
  • Case: %s
    • ' '
  • Source → Destination: %s → %s
    • ' '
  • Receipt: %s
    • ' '
  • Variance: %.2f%% (NGN %.2f)
    • ' '
  • Clearing Stock Entry: %s (Cr 1625 / Dr 2609)
    • ' '
  • Severity: %s
    • ' '
' '

Please investigate and either identify culpable staff (debit Staff Loan Receivable) ' 'or write off to 1609 - GIT - Transit Loss.

' ) % ( case.name, outgoing_doc.from_warehouse, doc.to_warehouse, doc.name, variance_pct, total_value, clearing.name, case.variance_severity ), reference_doctype='Inter-Outlet Variance Case', reference_name=case.name, now=False, ) except Exception as e: frappe.log_error(title='Inter-outlet case-open notify failed', message=str(e))

name: Inter-Outlet Auto-Receipt and Notify

# SCL — Stage 2 (corrected v2): per-outlet notification. if doc.purpose != 'Material Transfer': pass elif not (doc.get('add_to_transit') or 0): pass elif doc.get('outgoing_stock_entry'): pass else: git_wh = 'Goods In Transit - SCL' dest_wh = doc.get('final_destination_warehouse') if not dest_wh: frappe.throw('Final Destination Warehouse missing.') receipt = frappe.new_doc('Stock Entry') receipt.stock_entry_type = doc.stock_entry_type or 'Material Transfer' receipt.purpose = 'Material Transfer' receipt.add_to_transit = 0 receipt.company = doc.company receipt.from_warehouse = git_wh receipt.to_warehouse = dest_wh receipt.outgoing_stock_entry = doc.name receipt.transfer_purpose = doc.get('transfer_purpose') receipt.set_posting_time = 1 # Patch 0014b -- nudge receiving SE's posting_time +60s past the dispatch, # so when the receiving outlet submits immediately, Frappe's stock # ledger sees GIT populated before the drain. def p0014b_nudge(ts, seconds): # ts is 'HH:MM:SS' or 'HH:MM:SS.ffffff'; name: Inter-Outlet Variance Case Resolve
script:
# Patch 0015 -- IOVC Resolve with operational + party-liability paths + HoF gate.
if not doc.get('resolution'):
    frappe.throw('Resolution is required before submitting a variance case.')
if not (doc.get('hod_ops_signed_by') or '').strip():
    frappe.throw('HOD Ops sign-off is required before submitting a variance case.')

policy = frappe.get_doc('Sungas Close Policy', 'Sungas Close Policy')
suspense_acc = policy.get('it_suspense_account') or '2609 - Stock Variance In Transit Recovery - SCL'
writeoff_acc = policy.get('it_writeoff_account') or '1609 - GIT - Transit Loss - SCL'
recov_acc = policy.get('it_employee_recoverable_account') or '2900 - Staff Loan Receivable - SCL'
amount = doc.value_variance or 0
res = doc.resolution

# -----------------------------------------------------------------
# Group A: OPERATIONAL -- physical gas recovered; cancel the clearing MI
# and (optionally) create a reverse / redelivery Material Transfer.
# No GL entries beyond the cancellation reversal.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------
OPERATIONAL = ('Return to Source', 'Redeliver to another Outlet', 'Hold in GIT (Pending)')
if res in OPERATIONAL:
    if doc.get('operational_resolution_se'):
        pass  # idempotent -- already resolved
    else:
        # Step 1: cancel the auto-created clearing Material Issue so GIT is restored
        clearing_name = doc.get('clearing_stock_entry')
        if clearing_name and not doc.get('clearing_cancelled'):
            try:
                clearing = frappe.get_doc('Stock Entry', clearing_name)
                if clearing.docstatus == 1:
                    clearing.cancel()
                doc.clearing_cancelled = 1
            except Exception as e:
                frappe.log_error(title='IOVC clearing cancel failed', message=str(e))
                frappe.throw('Could not cancel clearing SE %s. See Error Log.' % clearing_name)
        # Step 2: physical movement
        git_wh = 'Goods In Transit - SCL'
        op_se = None
        if res == 'Return to Source':
            src = doc.get('source_warehouse')
            if not src:
                frappe.throw('Source Outlet is missing on this case; cannot return to source.')
            op_se = frappe.new_doc('Stock Entry')
            op_se.stock_entry_type = 'Material Transfer'
            op_se.purpose = 'Material Transfer'
            op_se.company = doc.company
            op_se.from_warehouse = git_wh
            op_se.to_warehouse = src
            op_se.set_posting_time = 1
            op_se.remarks = 'IOVC %s Return-to-Source. Physical gas returned to %s.' % (doc.name, src)
            # Pull row items from the clearing MI so qty is correct
            if clearing_name:
                src_items = frappe.get_all('Stock Entry Detail',
                    filters={'parent': clearing_name},
                    fields=['item_code', 'qty', 'basic_rate'])
                for r in src_items:
                    op_se.append('items', {
                        'item_code': r['item_code'], 'qty': r['qty'],
                        's_warehouse': git_wh, 't_warehouse': src,
                        'basic_rate': r['basic_rate'],
                    })
            op_se.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            op_se.submit()
        elif res == 'Redeliver to another Outlet':
            dest = doc.get('redelivery_destination')
            if not dest:
                frappe.throw('Redelivery Destination Warehouse is required for this resolution.')
            op_se = frappe.new_doc('Stock Entry')
            op_se.stock_entry_type = 'Material Transfer'
            op_se.purpose = 'Material Transfer'
            op_se.company = doc.company
            op_se.from_warehouse = git_wh
            op_se.to_warehouse = dest
            op_se.set_posting_time = 1
            op_se.remarks = 'IOVC %s Redelivery. Physical gas redelivered to %s.' % (doc.name, dest)
            if clearing_name:
                src_items = frappe.get_all('Stock Entry Detail',
                    filters={'parent': clearing_name},
                    fields=['item_code', 'qty', 'basic_rate'])
                for r in src_items:
                    op_se.append('items', {
                        'item_code': r['item_code'], 'qty': r['qty'],
                        's_warehouse': git_wh, 't_warehouse': dest,
                        'basic_rate': r['basic_rate'],
                    })
            op_se.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            op_se.submit()
        # 'Hold in GIT (Pending)' -- no new SE; the clearing cancellation leaves gas in GIT.
        if op_se:
            doc.operational_resolution_se = op_se.name

# -----------------------------------------------------------------
# Group B: NO ACTION -- already-corrected elsewhere.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------
elif res == 'No action / qty corrected separately':
    pass

# -----------------------------------------------------------------
# Group C: FINANCIAL -- JE moves suspense into recovery/write-off account.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------
elif amount <= 0:
    pass
elif doc.get('resolution_journal_entry'):
    pass  # idempotent
else:
    # Write-Off requires HoF sign-off (parity with TLVC Patch 0013)
    if res == 'Write-off as transit loss' and not (doc.get('hod_finance_signed_by') or '').strip():
        frappe.throw(
            'Inter-Outlet write-offs require explicit sign-off from LPG Head of Finance. '
            'Click the "Approve Write-Off as HoF" button on this case first '
            '(available only to the HoF role).'
        )
    je = frappe.new_doc('Journal Entry')
    je.voucher_type = 'Journal Entry'
    je.company = doc.company
    je.posting_date = frappe.utils.today()
    if res == 'Identify culpable staff and recover':
        if not doc.get('culpable_employee'):
            frappe.throw('Culpable Employee is required for staff recovery resolution.')
        je.user_remark = ('Stage 2.2: clear suspense to Staff Loan Receivable for variance case %s. '
                          'Culpable employee: %s. Amount NGN %.2f.' %
                          (doc.name, doc.culpable_employee, amount))
        je.append('accounts', {'account': suspense_acc, 'credit_in_account_currency': amount, 'debit_in_account_currency': 0})
        je.append('accounts', {
            'account': recov_acc, 'party_type': 'Employee', 'party': doc.culpable_employee,
            'debit_in_account_currency': amount, 'credit_in_account_currency': 0,
        })
    elif res == 'Driver Liable':
        if not doc.get('culpable_employee'):
            frappe.throw('Culpable Employee (driver) is required for Driver Liable resolution.')
        je.user_remark = 'Inter-Outlet variance %s -- in-house driver %s liable. Amount NGN %.2f.' % (
            doc.name, doc.culpable_employee, amount)
        je.append('accounts', {'account': suspense_acc, 'credit_in_account_currency': amount})
        je.append('accounts', {
            'account': recov_acc, 'party_type': 'Employee', 'party': doc.culpable_employee,
            'debit_in_account_currency': amount,
        })
    elif res == 'Hauler Liable':
        if not doc.get('hauler'):
            frappe.throw('Hauler is required for Hauler Liable resolution. Set the hauler supplier on the dispatching SE.')
        co = frappe.get_doc('Company', doc.company)
        payable_account = co.default_payable_account
        if not payable_account:
            frappe.throw('Company default payable account not set; cannot post hauler charge.')
        je.user_remark = 'Inter-Outlet variance %s -- 3rd-party hauler %s liable. Amount NGN %.2f.' % (
            doc.name, doc.hauler, amount)
        je.append('accounts', {
            'account': payable_account, 'party_type': 'Supplier', 'party': doc.hauler,
            'debit_in_account_currency': amount, 'company': doc.company,
        })
        je.append('accounts', {'account': suspense_acc, 'credit_in_account_currency': amount})
    elif res == 'Write-off as transit loss':
        je.user_remark = ('Stage 2.2: write off variance case %s to 1609 - GIT - Transit Loss. '
                          'HoF-approved by %s. Amount NGN %.2f.' %
                          (doc.name, doc.hod_finance_signed_by, amount))
        je.append('accounts', {'account': suspense_acc, 'credit_in_account_currency': amount})
        je.append('accounts', {'account': writeoff_acc, 'debit_in_account_currency': amount})
    else:
        frappe.throw('Unknown resolution value: %s' % res)
    je.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    je.submit()
    doc.resolution_journal_entry = je.name

SE Transit Posting-Time Collision Guard
script:
# Patch 0014b -- Posting-Time Collision Guard.
# When 2+ operators submit sibling multi-drop receiving SEs at the SAME
# wall-clock second, Frappe's stock ledger reads GIT balance as 0 for
# the second submitter and throws 'Insufficient Stock'. This guard
# detects the collision and auto-nudges this doc's posting_time to
# max(sibling_posting_time) + 1 second so the ledger has an
# unambiguous order.
#
# Applies to Stock Entries that reference:
#   - outgoing_stock_entry (inter-outlet multi-drop pattern), OR
#   - pr_reference_new / pr_reference (PR -> outlet discharge pattern)
#
# Safe: never raises. Nudges silently; the operator sees their SE submit.
def p0014b_nudge(ts, seconds):
    # ts is 'HH:MM:SS' or 'HH:MM:SS.ffffff'; return a nudged HH:MM:SS
    # clamped to 23:59:59.
    if not ts:
        ts = '00:00:00'
    parts = str(ts).split(':')
    hh = int(parts[0]); mm = int(parts[1]); ss = int(float(parts[2]))
    total = hh * 3600 + mm * 60 + ss + int(seconds)
    if total >= 86400:
        total = 86399
    nh = total // 3600
    nm = (total % 3600) // 60
    nss = total % 60
    return '%02d:%02d:%02d' % (nh, nm, nss)
def p0014b_time_to_sec(ts):
    if not ts:
        return 0
    parts = str(ts).split(':')
    return int(parts[0]) * 3600 + int(parts[1]) * 60 + int(float(parts[2]))
sibling_filters = None
if doc.get('outgoing_stock_entry'):
    sibling_filters = {
        'outgoing_stock_entry': doc.outgoing_stock_entry,
        'posting_date': doc.posting_date,
        'docstatus': 1,
        'name': ['!=', doc.name],
    }
elif doc.get('pr_reference_new'):
    sibling_filters = {
        'pr_reference_new': doc.pr_reference_new,
        'posting_date': doc.posting_date,
        'docstatus': 1,
        'name': ['!=', doc.name],
    }
elif doc.get('pr_reference'):
    sibling_filters = {
        'pr_reference': doc.pr_reference,
        'posting_date': doc.posting_date,
        'docstatus': 1,
        'name': ['!=', doc.name],
    }
if sibling_filters:
    siblings = frappe.get_all('Stock Entry',
        filters=sibling_filters,
        fields=['name', 'posting_time'])
    if siblings:
        max_sec = 0
        max_name = None
        for sib in siblings:
            s = p0014b_time_to_sec(sib.get('posting_time'))
            if s > max_sec:
                max_sec = s
                max_name = sib.get('name')
        this_sec = p0014b_time_to_sec(doc.posting_time)
        if this_sec <= max_sec:
            new_ts = p0014b_nudge(doc.posting_time, (max_sec - this_sec) + 1)
            doc.set_posting_time = 1
            doc.posting_time = new_ts
            frappe.log_error(
                title='SE Posting-Time Collision Auto-Nudged',
                message=('SE %s: posting_time collided with sibling %s. '
                         'Auto-nudged to %s to preserve stock-ledger ordering.'
                        ) % (doc.name or 'new', max_name, new_ts)
            )
